orgDesign.companyProfile: Multi-brand consumer media platform centered on audience habit, editorial packaging, subscriptions, premium advertising, and partner monetization.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Audience teams own direct habit, personalization, registration, and subscriptions. Editorial platform teams own authoring, asset workflows, and distribution packaging. Revenue teams own advertising, commerce, and bundle monetization. Shared platform teams own identity, consent, measurement, and revenue operations.
designPrinciples: Keep front-door growth, newsletters, and registration close together because known audience growth compounds across the portfolio.
Keep CMS, live publishing, and distribution packaging close to the newsroom because monetization quality starts with publish-time choices.
Keep identity, consent, and measurement tightly coupled to subscriptions and advertising because audience value depends on trusted first-party data.
orgDesign.staffingPrinciple: Model total staffing around 250 FTE across delivery teams and group leadership; keep every delivery team at 6-10 FTE, with no individual team above 10 people.
orgDesign.groupingPrinciple: Use top-level groups for audience growth, editorial platform, revenue and partnerships, and shared foundations.
orgDesign.groupLeadershipPrinciple: Every group has explicit lightweight leadership: a Head of group, product and engineering directors, and principal/staff-plus IC coverage for architecture, product quality, and cross-team standards.
